verdict.rationale: TrueLayer documents payment mandates for recurring payments, but a payment created on a mandate 'executes immediately', which makes it a one-off action triggered by the integrator. The pack documents no scheduler or recurring job/workflow capability in the product itself. Mandates are a developer building block for recurring payments, not a recurring schedule, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: any documented scheduling of recurring jobs or workflows, cron-like or interval-based execution, and management of scheduled runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: You'll need this mandate to set up recurring payments.
Once you create a payment on an authorised mandate, it executes immediately without requiring further user authorisation.
